title: Custom Deck Spec
description: Filter spec for make_deck.py. All fields are optional — omit to include all values.

description.description: Free-text description of the target learner or goal (not used for filtering).

role.description: Include cards tagged with at least one of these role: values (without prefix). Omit to include all roles.

must.description: Card must match at least one of these domain: values (without prefix).

include.description: After must-filtering, prefer cards from these domains to fill up to max_cards.

exclude.description: Never include cards from these domains.

level.description: Include only cards at these difficulty levels. Omit to include all.

style.description: Include only cards of these question styles (without prefix). Omit to include all.

max_cards.description: Hard cap on total cards in the output deck. Default: 200.
